# compute_p_array {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
compute_p_array(data, d1, d2; chart_choice=TauTilde(), refinement=OrdinaryType(),
  add_noise=false)
```
Compute the relative SOP type frequencies of every image in an image sequence at lag `(d1, d2)`. These frequencies are the input of the bootstrap functions [`arl_sop_bootstrap`](arl_sop_bootstrap.qmd) and [`cl_sop_bootstrap`](cl_sop_bootstrap.qmd).
 
Returns a matrix with one row per image and one column per SOP type (3 for [`OrdinaryType`](OrdinaryType.qmd), 6 for a refined classification).
 
  * `data::Array{T,3}`: image sequence (third dimension = time).
  * `d1::Int`: row delay.
  * `d2::Int`: column delay.
  * `chart_choice=TauTilde()`: chart the frequencies are computed for. It determines how the SOP types are grouped; see [`stat_sop`](stat_sop.qmd) for the available charts.
  * `refinement=OrdinaryType()`: [`OrdinaryType`](OrdinaryType.qmd)`()` or one of [`RotationType`](RotationType.qmd)`()`, [`DirectionType`](DirectionType.qmd)`()`, [`DiagonalType`](DiagonalType.qmd)`()`.
  * `add_noise=false`: add uniform noise to the data to break ties.


:::
